title: Global View - The 7 Wonders Of The World
audio: mp3/352. Global View - The 7 Wonders Of The World.mp3

segments.en: Hello everyone and welcome to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 大家好，欢迎来到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: My name is Catherine.
segments.zh: 我叫 Catherine。

segments.en: And today, Marco, we're talking about some very special places, right?
segments.zh: 而今天，马可，我们正在谈论一些非常特别的地方，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Today we're going to talk about the famous list of the seven wonders of the world.
segments.zh: 今天，我们将讨论世界七大奇迹的著名名单。

segments.en: So you've probably heard about this before.
segments.zh: 所以你可能以前听说过这个。

segments.en: We're not going to tell you what this means quite yet.
segments.zh: 我们不会告诉你这意味着什么。

segments.en: Take a listen to today's dialogue.
segments.zh: 听听今天的对话。

segments.en: And when we come back, we'll talk a little bit more about what these wonders are and where they are.
segments.zh: 当我们回来时，我们将更多地讨论这些奇迹是什么以及它们在哪里。

segments.en: Have you seen this news article?
segments.zh: 你看过这篇新闻文章吗？

segments.en: Apparently an organization has made a list to name the new seven wonders of the world and people could vote for them online.
segments.zh: 听说有个机构列出了“新世界七大奇迹”候选名单，让大家在网上投票。

segments.en: Wow, that's really interesting.
segments.zh: 哇，这真的很有趣。

segments.en: So who won?
segments.zh: 那谁入选了？

segments.en: Well, the Great Wall of China, the Taj Mahal in India.
segments.zh: 有中国的长城、印度的泰姬陵。

segments.en: I've been there.
segments.zh: 我也经历过。

segments.en: It really is an amazing work of architecture and art.
segments.zh: 它真是一件令人惊叹的建筑与艺术杰作。

segments.en: The entire complex is made of white marble and in the interior of the tomb, the walls are covered with gems and emeralds.
segments.zh: 整座建筑群都由白色大理石建成，陵墓内部的墙上还镶着宝石和祖母绿。

segments.en: Cool.
segments.zh: 真酷。

segments.en: Also amongst the winners is Petra in Jordan, Machu Picchu in Peru, and the pyramid in Chichen Itza in Mexico.
segments.zh: 入选的还有约旦的佩特拉古城、秘鲁的马丘比丘，以及墨西哥奇琴伊察的金字塔。

segments.en: Wait a minute.
segments.zh: 等一下。

segments.en: It also says that the Christ Redeemer statue in Brazil and the Colosseum in Rome are wonders.
segments.zh: 上面还说，巴西的基督救世主像和罗马斗兽场也入选了。

segments.en: I would love to go to Italy and see the Colosseum, stand in the middle like a gladiator.
segments.zh: 我真想去意大利看看斗兽场，像角斗士那样站在场中央。

segments.en: Well, let's see if we can find some cheap airfare and we can go towards the end of the year.
segments.zh: 看看能不能买到便宜机票，年底去一趟吧。

segments.en: Good idea.
segments.zh: 好主意。

segments.en: All right, we're back.
segments.zh: 好了，我们回来了。

segments.en: So let's talk about these very interesting places all over the world.
segments.zh: 所以让我们谈谈世界各地这些非常有趣的地方。

segments.en: Now on Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 现在在语言外卖。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: So the set phrase for this, Marco, is the seven wonders of the world.
segments.zh: 因此，马可的设定短语是世界的七大奇迹。

segments.en: Now the key here is the word wonder.
segments.zh: 现在这里的关键是奇迹这个词。

segments.en: What is a wonder?
segments.zh: 什么是奇迹？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: A wonder is something very amazing, incredible.
segments.zh: 一个奇迹是非常惊人的，令人难以置信的东西。

segments.en: It's something that's beyond your imagination almost.
segments.zh: 这几乎是超出您的想象的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: You can't even imagine how man or how someone created it.
segments.zh: 你甚至无法想象人是如何创造的。

segments.en: And so wonderful is a similar word that's an adjective, something that's just great, fantastic is wonderful.
segments.zh: 如此美妙的词是一个形容词，非常棒的词，太棒了，太棒了。

segments.en: A wonder is something very, very special.
segments.zh: 一个奇迹是非常非常特别的东西。

segments.en: And here we have seven of them.
segments.zh: 在这里，我们有七个。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And it's a list basically that you can see even online about these wonders all over the world and they're so special because they are amazing works of art and architecture.
segments.zh: 它是一个列表，您甚至可以在网上看到有关世界各地这些奇迹的列表，它们非常特别，因为它们是令人惊叹的艺术和建筑作品。

segments.en: And starting off with one of the most famous ones is in China.
segments.zh: 最著名的之一是在中国。

segments.en: It's the Great Wall of China.
segments.zh: 这是中国的长城。

segments.en: I think what's special about this I've heard is that when astronauts are in space, it's so long and so distinct they can actually see the Great Wall.
segments.zh: 我想我听说的特别之处在于，当宇航员在太空中时，它是如此漫长和独特，他们实际上可以看到长城。

segments.en: Yeah, that's what I've heard as well.
segments.zh: 是的，这也是我所听到的。

segments.en: It's a very long wall, thousands of kilometers long.
segments.zh: 这是一堵很长的墙，几千公里长。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And it goes east to west all across the northern border of China.
segments.zh: 它从中国的北部边界向东向西延伸。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's a very big wall.
segments.zh: 所以这是一堵非常大的墙。

segments.en: And what's interesting about it is that it was built such a long time ago and that the techniques used to make it were very special.
segments.zh: 有趣的是，它是很久以前建造的，而且用来制作它的技术非常特别。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And sometimes you might hear us talk about the Great Wall instead of the Great Wall of China.
segments.zh: 有时你可能会听到我们谈论长城而不是中国的长城。

segments.en: And so that's just a hint.
segments.zh: 所以这只是一个暗示。

segments.en: It's easy to say Great Wall.
segments.zh: 说长城很容易。

segments.en: You can say them both ways though.
segments.zh: 不过，你可以两种方式说。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Now moving west towards India, we have another very amazing work of architecture.
segments.zh: 现在向西移动到印度，我们有另一件非常了不起的建筑作品。

segments.en: It's called the Taj Mahal.
segments.zh: 它被称为泰姬陵。

segments.en: Now the Taj Mahal is in North India in a city called Agra.
segments.zh: 现在泰姬陵位于印度北部的一个叫阿格拉的城市。

segments.en: And it's very special because it's massive, it's very big, and it's all white marble.
segments.zh: 它非常特别，因为它很大，非常大，而且全是白色大理石。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And it's interesting because this place, the Taj Mahal, is not really a temple.
segments.zh: 这很有趣，因为这个地方，泰姬陵，并不是真正的寺庙。

segments.en: It was actually a tomb.
segments.zh: 它实际上是一座坟墓。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Now that's an interesting word to look at.
segments.zh: 现在这是一个有趣的词。

segments.en: A tomb is a place where we bury someone, you know, after someone dies.
segments.zh: 坟墓是我们在有人死后埋葬某人的地方。

segments.en: Maybe if you have a lot of money, you're very rich, you want to put that body in a very special sacred place.
segments.zh: 也许如果你有很多钱，你很富有，你想把那具尸体放在一个非常特殊的神圣地方。

segments.en: And that's called a tomb.
segments.zh: 这就是所谓的坟墓。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this is actually what the Taj Mahal is.
segments.zh: 所以这实际上就是泰姬陵。

segments.en: Now we saw in the dialogue that the entire complex of the Taj Mahal is made of white marble.
segments.zh: 现在我们在对话中看到泰姬陵的整个建筑群都是由白色大理石制成的。

segments.en: So when we talk about the entire complex, what do we mean?
segments.zh: 那么当我们谈论整个情结时，我们是什么意思？

segments.en: Well complex here is a noun.
segments.zh: 好复杂这里是一个名词。

segments.en: You might have heard it in other situations where it's an adjective, it means something different.
segments.zh: 你可能在其他情况下听说过，它是一个形容词，它意味着不同的东西。

segments.en: But here a complex means many buildings together, right?
segments.zh: 但这里的复杂意味着许多建筑在一起，对吧？

segments.en: So you can say the Taj Mahal is one building.
segments.zh: 所以你可以说泰姬陵是一栋建筑。

segments.en: But the Taj Mahal complex maybe has four or five buildings together.
segments.zh: 但泰姬陵建筑群可能有四五座建筑。

segments.en: So a side temple and a gatehouse.
segments.zh: 所以是一侧的寺庙和一个门楼。

segments.en: And so we say a complex is a grouping of buildings.
segments.zh: 所以我们说综合体是一组建筑物。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So now let's move on.
segments.zh: 所以现在让我们继续前进。

segments.en: Let's take a look at Language Takeaway Part 2 and let's continue talking about these wonders of the world.
segments.zh: 让我们看一下语言外卖第 2 部分，让我们继续谈论这些世界的奇迹。

segments.en: Now the top of our list in Language Takeaway Part 2 is actually a place I would love to go to.
segments.zh: 现在，我们在语言外卖第 2 部分中的首选实际上是我很想去的地方。

segments.en: I've never been there.
segments.zh: 我从来没有去过那里。

segments.en: It's in Jordan, which is a country in the Middle East and it's called Petra.
segments.zh: 它在约旦，它是中东的一个国家，它被称为佩特拉。

segments.en: Petra.
segments.zh: 佩特拉。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So it's actually a city but it's also known as the lost city of Petra, right?
segments.zh: 所以它实际上是一座城市，但它也被称为失落的佩特拉之城，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And what's unique about this city is that the city is built.
segments.zh: 这座城市的独特之处在于这座城市的建成。

segments.en: It's carved out of stone in this cliff.
segments.zh: 它是用石头雕刻而成的。

segments.en: So it's not just pieces of stone put together.
segments.zh: 所以这不仅仅是拼凑在一起的石头。

segments.en: It's actually inside the rocks.
segments.zh: 它实际上在岩石内。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So it's very famous.
segments.zh: 所以非常有名。

segments.en: You've probably seen it in movies like Indiana Jones.
segments.zh: 你可能在印第安纳琼斯这样的电影中看过它。

segments.en: There's a big part of the scenes that go on inside Petra.
segments.zh: 佩特拉内部发生的大部分场景都在发生。

segments.en: Very special place and again very unique.
segments.zh: 非常特别的地方，又非常独特。

segments.en: Now the next site is actually very far away in South America and again it's ancient and very intricate.
segments.zh: 现在下一个站点实际上在南美很远，而且它又古老且非常复杂。

segments.en: It's called Machu Picchu.
segments.zh: 它被称为马丘比丘。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So this is in one of those very old cities that are actually in ruins now and the interesting thing about it is that it's very high up in like a little mountain.
segments.zh: 所以这是在那些现在实际上是废墟的非常古老的城市之一，有趣的是它就像一座小山一样高。

segments.en: And those mountains there, those are the Andes, right?
segments.zh: 还有那些山，那些是安第斯山脉，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So Machu Picchu, also a very famous place.
segments.zh: 所以马丘比丘，也是一个非常有名的地方。

segments.en: Many visitors from all over the world go there as well.
segments.zh: 来自世界各地的许多游客也去了那里。

segments.en: And another main attraction around the world are the pyramids.
segments.zh: 世界上另一个主要景点是金字塔。

segments.en: So we have some pyramids in Egypt.
segments.zh: 所以我们在埃及有一些金字塔。

segments.en: I think those are the most well-known ones.
segments.zh: 我认为这些是最著名的。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: The pyramids in Egypt like the Pyramid of Giza are very big structures.
segments.zh: 埃及的金字塔，如吉萨金字塔是非常大的结构。

segments.en: I mean they're huge and they were built thousands of years ago but they're still here because they were built so well.
segments.zh: 我的意思是它们是巨大的，它们是在数千年前建造的，但它们仍然在这里，因为它们建造得很好。

segments.en: But there are also very famous pyramids like the one we heard about today in the dialogue in Mexico.
segments.zh: 但也有一些非常著名的金字塔，就像我们今天在墨西哥的对话中听到的那样。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's a little bit different though because the pyramids as we, most of us know them, they're very smooth on the sides you would say.
segments.zh: 不过，这有点不同，因为我们大多数人都知道它们的金字塔，它们的两侧非常光滑。

segments.en: Yeah, you can't climb on them really, right?
segments.zh: 是的，你真的不能爬上它们，对吧？

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Well this one in Mexico actually has kind of like steps.
segments.zh: 好吧，这在墨西哥的这一步实际上有一些类似的步骤。

segments.en: So it's a different type of pyramid but the shape is very similar.
segments.zh: 所以它是一种不同类型的金字塔，但形状非常相似。

segments.en: Alright.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So the pyramids here are in a place called Chichen Itza.
segments.zh: 所以这里的金字塔位于一个叫奇琴伊察的地方。

segments.en: You might have heard of that.
segments.zh: 你可能听说过。

segments.en: And we have another place though which is also in South America in the city of Rio de Janeiro.
segments.zh: 我们还有另一个地方，也在南美里约热内卢市。

segments.en: Now this one is actually a statue, right?
segments.zh: 现在这个实际上是一尊雕像，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: It's called the Christ Redeemer.
segments.zh: 它被称为基督救赎主。

segments.en: It's a very big statue, very famous.
segments.zh: 这是一个非常大的雕像，非常有名。

segments.en: You've seen it maybe in pictures.
segments.zh: 你可能在图片中看到过。

segments.en: It's a statue of Jesus with his arms open.
segments.zh: 这是一尊耶稣的雕像，张开双臂。

segments.en: Now the word Redeemer, okay, a Redeemer is a person, someone who does something, who redeems.
segments.zh: 现在救赎者这个词，好吧，救赎主是一个人，做某事的人，救赎的人。

segments.en: What does it mean to be a Redeemer?
segments.zh: 成为救赎主意味着什么？

segments.en: Well, a Redeemer is a person that saves souls for example.
segments.zh: 例如，救赎主是拯救灵魂的人。

segments.en: So if you redeem yourself, you're redeeming yourself of your sins maybe.
segments.zh: 因此，如果您赎回自己，您可能是在赎回自己的罪孽。

segments.en: Well yeah, you're taking value back, right?
segments.zh: 是的，你正在取回价值，对吧？

segments.en: And so in the case of Jesus, he is taking away the sins of the world and he's redeeming, you know, that's why his arms are out.
segments.zh: 所以在耶稣的情况下，他正在除去世界的罪恶，他正在赎回，你知道，这就是他的手臂伸出的原因。

segments.en: He's redeeming all people.
segments.zh: 他正在救赎所有人。

segments.en: And that's the idea I think behind the Christ Redeemer statue.
segments.zh: 这就是我认为基督救赎主雕像背后的想法。

segments.en: So the verb redeem, like you can use it in everyday life if you take a coupon and you redeem it.
segments.zh: 所以动词赎回，就像你可以在日常生活中使用它，你可以使用优惠券并赎回它。

segments.en: That means you, yeah, you collect the value.
segments.zh: 这意味着你，是的，你收集价值。

segments.en: You collect the value, right?
segments.zh: 你收集价值，对吧？

segments.en: So you can use it, actually this word in everyday life.
segments.zh: 所以你可以使用它，实际上在日常生活中这个词。

segments.en: You can.
segments.zh: 你可以。

segments.en: And moving on now towards Europe, we have the famous Colosseum.
segments.zh: 现在继续前往欧洲，我们拥有着名的斗兽场。

segments.en: Ooh, now I love this one.
segments.zh: 哦，现在我喜欢这一款。

segments.en: I've actually been there and I know you have too recently.
segments.zh: 我实际上去过那里，我知道你最近也去过那里。

segments.en: But this is a circular, like a round stadium.
segments.zh: 但这是一个圆形，就像一个圆形的体育场。

segments.en: So it's a place where you play sports.
segments.zh: 所以这是一个你参加体育运动的地方。

segments.en: Well, you did.
segments.zh: 好吧，你做到了。

segments.en: It was from, you know, thousands of years ago, the Roman Empire.
segments.zh: 你知道，它来自数千年前的罗马帝国。

segments.en: And it's in very good shape I would say.
segments.zh: 我会说它的状态非常好。

segments.en: You can still see it.
segments.zh: 你仍然可以看到它。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's actually called the Colosseum, although a Colosseum as we know it now can also be the same thing, right?
segments.zh: 所以它实际上被称为斗兽场，尽管我们现在所知道的斗兽场也可能是一样的，对吧？

segments.en: A structure where sports or activities are played.
segments.zh: 进行运动或活动的结构。

segments.en: Basically, yeah, a Colosseum is an old stadium.
segments.zh: 基本上，是的，斗兽场是一个古老的体育场。

segments.en: But the Colosseum, like you said, is definitely the Colosseum in Rome.
segments.zh: 但就像你说的，罗马斗兽场绝对是罗马的斗兽场。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And we've probably seen movies of ancient Rome where sports or activities were taking place, specifically gladiator fights.
segments.zh: 我们可能已经看过正在进行体育或活动的古罗马电影，特别是角斗士的战斗。

segments.en: So that's our word there, gladiator.
segments.zh: 所以这是我们的话，角斗士。

segments.en: Yeah, that's right.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: A gladiator is actually a person.
segments.zh: 角斗士实际上是一个人。

segments.en: And a gladiator was a man who thousands of years ago during the Roman Empire would fight maybe other men or animals and he had to fight to stay alive.
segments.zh: 角斗士是数千年前在罗马帝国期间可能与其他人或动物作战的人，他必须战斗才能维持生计。

segments.en: So that was his profession basically, to be a gladiator.
segments.zh: 所以这基本上就是他的职业，成为角斗士。

segments.en: So now as you are a boxer, back then you were a gladiator.
segments.zh: 所以现在你是一名拳击手，那时你是一个角斗士。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And there are actually some very famous movies about gladiators, like the movie Gladiator with Russell Crowe.
segments.zh: 实际上有一些关于角斗士的非常著名的电影，比如罗素克劳的电影《角斗士》。

segments.en: So it's a pretty common word these days.
segments.zh: 所以现在这是一个很常见的词。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So let's take a break.
segments.zh: 所以让我们休息一下。

segments.en: We'll be back in a bit.
segments.zh: 我们一会儿回来。

segments.en: Have you seen this news article?
segments.zh: 你看过这篇新闻文章吗？

segments.en: Apparently, an organization has made a list to name the new Seven Wonders of the World, and people could vote for them online.
segments.zh: 显然，一个组织已经列出了一个名单来命名世界上的新七大奇迹，人们可以在网上投票给它们。

segments.en: Wow, that's really interesting.
segments.zh: 哇，这真的很有趣。

segments.en: So, who won?
segments.zh: 那么，谁赢了？

segments.en: Well, the Great Wall of China, the Taj Mahal in India.
segments.zh: 有中国的长城、印度的泰姬陵。

segments.en: I've been there!
segments.zh: 我去过那里！

segments.en: It really is an amazing work of architecture and art.
segments.zh: 它真是一件令人惊叹的建筑与艺术杰作。

segments.en: The entire complex is made of white marble, and in the interior of the tomb, the walls are covered with gems and emeralds.
segments.zh: 整个建筑群由白色大理石制成，在坟墓内部，墙壁上覆盖着宝石和祖母绿。

segments.en: Cool!
segments.zh: 酷!

segments.en: Also amongst the winners is Petra in Jordan, Machu Picchu in Peru, and the pyramid in Chichen Itza in Mexico.
segments.zh: 入选的还有约旦的佩特拉古城、秘鲁的马丘比丘，以及墨西哥奇琴伊察的金字塔。

segments.en: Wait a minute. It also says that the Christ Redeemer statue in Brazil and the Colosseum in Rome are wonders.
segments.zh: 等一下。 它还说，巴西的基督救赎者雕像和罗马的斗兽场是奇迹。

segments.en: I would love to go to Italy and see the Colosseum, stand in the middle like a gladiator.
segments.zh: 我真想去意大利看看斗兽场，像角斗士那样站在场中央。

segments.en: Well, let's see if we can find some cheap airfare and we can go towards the end of the year.
segments.zh: 看看能不能买到便宜机票，年底去一趟吧。

segments.en: Good idea!
segments.zh: 主意！

segments.en: All right, so this list that we gave you are actually the new Seven Wonders of the World. It was voted online.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们给你的这份清单实际上是世界上新的七大奇迹。 它是在网上投票的。

segments.en: People all over the world out of different candidates or different places that were considered to be the new seven wonders of the world.
segments.zh: 世界各地的人们都从不同的候选人或被认为是世界新七大奇迹的不同地方出来。

segments.en: Among those, like some of them that didn't win for example was Angkor Wat in Cambodia.
segments.zh: 其中，像其中一些没有获胜的人是柬埔寨的吴哥窟。

segments.en: Yeah, I never understood that.
segments.zh: 是的，我一直不明白这一点。

segments.en: I think Angkor Wat is such an amazing place and so big and it was the heart of this old civilization.
segments.zh: 我认为吴哥窟是一个如此神奇的地方，如此之大，它是这个古老文明的核心。

segments.en: And instead we have other things like a statue.
segments.zh: 相反，我们还有其他东西，比如雕像。

segments.en: Yeah, I don't agree with it as well.
segments.zh: 是的，我也不同意。

segments.en: But actually the Statue of Liberty of the United States was also considered as a candidate for a wonder of the world.
segments.zh: 但实际上，美国自由女神像也被认为是世界奇迹的候选者。

segments.en: Well, that's right.
segments.zh: 嗯，没错。

segments.en: America doesn't have any wonders.
segments.zh: 美国没有什么奇迹。

segments.en: You have natural wonders I think.
segments.zh: 我认为你有自然奇观。

segments.en: The Grand Canyon is considered I think one of those natural wonders.
segments.zh: 大峡谷被认为是我认为的自然奇观之一。

segments.en: Yes, I think Niagara Falls also maybe.
segments.zh: 是的，我认为尼亚加拉瀑布也可能。

segments.en: But that's an interesting point though, Marco.
segments.zh: 但这是一个有趣的观点，马可。

segments.en: We've got the great wonders of the world and we've got the natural wonders.
segments.zh: 我们有世界上的伟大奇迹，我们有自然奇观。

segments.en: What's the difference?
segments.zh: 有什么区别？

segments.en: Well, a natural wonder of the world means that it's there naturally.
segments.zh: 好吧，世界上的自然奇观意味着它自然存在。

segments.en: It's not man-made.
segments.zh: 这不是人造的。

segments.en: All of these things that we see here, somebody had to make them.
segments.zh: 我们在这里看到的所有这些东西，必须有人制作它们。

segments.en: Whereas for example the Grand Canyon or Niagara Falls, they are there naturally.
segments.zh: 例如大峡谷或尼亚加拉大瀑布，它们自然而然地存在。

segments.en: It's by nature.
segments.zh: 这是天生的。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So man-made versus natural or made by nature.
segments.zh: 所以人造与自然或自然制造。

segments.en: Right. So it's very interesting because you have like we said natural seven wonders of the world.
segments.zh: 对。 所以这很有趣，因为你喜欢我们说的世界七大自然奇观。

segments.en: You have these, the new ones.
segments.zh: 你有这些，新的。

segments.en: You have the ancient world wonders which like none of them exist anymore.
segments.zh: 你有古代世界的奇迹，它们不再存在。

segments.en: I think only the pyramids.
segments.zh: 我认为只有金字塔。

segments.en: That's right. The hanging gardens of Babylon and the colossus at Rhodes.
segments.zh: 没错。 巴比伦的空中花园和罗得岛的巨像。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Yeah, those ones are very cool but not like you said, not around anymore.
segments.zh: 是的，那些很酷，但不像你说的，现在不在了。

segments.en: But maybe some of you actually, maybe your countries were considered to host one of these wonders or maybe you voted for some of them.
segments.zh: 但也许你们中的一些人实际上，也许你们的国家被认为是这些奇迹之一，或者你投票给了其中一些奇迹。

segments.en: Yeah, let us know.
segments.zh: 是的，让我们知道。

segments.en: What is a wonder where you come from?
segments.zh: 你来自哪里的奇迹是什么？

segments.en: It doesn't have to be on this list.
segments.zh: 它不必在这个列表中。

segments.en: It can be something you think is wonderful.
segments.zh: 它可以是你认为很棒的东西。

segments.en: Let us know.
segments.zh: 告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right. We'll see you guys there.
segments.zh: 好的。 我们会在那里见到你们。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。

segments.en: Bye.
segments.zh: 再见。
